write_policy.replacement: A new user confirmation creates a new versioned receipt; this receipt is never edited in place.
write_policy.auditor_rule: Compare the current envelope bytes to envelope_digest and reject any mismatch.

limitations: This receipt is durable workflow evidence. It is not an ACI runtime authority receipt and cannot authorize launch without the existing hook-issued ACI launch-authorized receipt.
